description: This file defines the DataGroup entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a data group with properties such as permissions and descriptive fields. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a data group with permission flags and relationships to permissions collections.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the DataGroup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the DataGroup.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the DataGroup.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the DataGroup has read permission.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the DataGroup has create permission.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the DataGroup has update permission.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the DataGroup has delete permission.
